Definition: Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeush is the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites, spread across the generations. He is a son of Esau by Aholibamah, named in the genealogy of Edom, and a son of Rehoboam by Mahalath, and the written form of his name in Genesis is Jeish. One name, five men, all of them kept in the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps five men under one name, and the Edomite and the Israelites are not confused in His book. My position is that the name Jeush belongs to Esau's house and to David's house alike, and God knows each one.
